_README: Frozen runtime constants per docs/semaphore-translator-spec.md §4.4. Both platforms load and parse this file; values are never hardcoded in Swift/Kotlin. Changing a value here changes behavior on both platforms identically.

_field_notes.ANGLE_TOLERANCE_DEG: max deviation from a 45-degree canonical position to accept; beyond this the arm is indeterminate
_field_notes.MIN_KEYPOINT_CONFIDENCE: below this per-keypoint visibility, the arm is indeterminate
_field_notes.COMMIT_HOLD_MS: how long a stable pose must hold (wall-clock ms) before being committed to output (ADR 0004)
_field_notes.INTER_CHAR_GAP_MS: minimum intervening indeterminate gap (ms) before the SAME symbol may re-commit; a distinct symbol commits on its hold alone (ADR 0004, deviates from a literal 'next character' reading)
_field_notes.SMOOTHING_WINDOW: frames of plurality-vote smoothing (ties to the most-recent occurrence) on the predicted mode-independent pose symbol (the classify output, not the emitted character); see ADR 0004
